deliverables: Allocate capital to builders intended to improve Cardano ecosystem KPIs including monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Continue development of public and increasingly on-chain KPI tracking for funded projects.
Run proposal evaluation, feedback coordination, fund distribution, and results tracking through a smart contract-governed DAO process.
Disburse funds only after milestone completion is validated and confirmed by the administrator.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with treasury withdrawal received and administered by an independent council/multisig composed of dRep DAO members before milestone-based disbursement.
request.what: Cardano Builder DAO treasury withdrawal to operate and scale a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The proposal says Cardano Builder DAO is a smart contract-governed funding mechanism designed to allocate capital to builders advancing Vision 2030 KPIs such as MAU, monthly transactions, and TVL.
The proposer claims the DAO built Version 1 and Version 2 of a KPI dashboard, moving from self-reported KPI tracking toward tracking tied to live on-chain Cardano data.
Funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions as core KPIs.
The proposer claims Cardano Builder DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

The proposal states Round 1 included 38 voting members, 27 requesting members, 20 funded companies, 83% governance participation, and 5,541,335 ADA distributed through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
The proposal states Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and achieved 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposer claims official Cardano developer documentation describes CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to activity, users, and TVL.

The proposal says an independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional non-affiliated active dRep will receive, hold, review, and oversee milestone-based disbursement of funds.
The proposal commits that ADA held before disbursement will be kept in separate auditable accounts, not delegated to any stake pool operator, and delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposal states CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the Cardano Treasury after the first two governance rounds and provides an adastat transaction URL.

summary: The document requests 20,000,000 ADA for Cardano Builder DAO to continue a builder-led, KPI-oriented treasury allocation mechanism with independent administration, milestone-based disbursement, KPI reporting, and repayment of unused funds.
